title: Good Cleanser, but Overpriced
text: Good Cleanser, but Overpriced. A bit pricey for 2 bottles of all-purpose cleaner, which accounts for the 4-star review, this is a very good cleaner. It works as well as most store-bought brands that are less expensive.

product_metadata.title: Beyond Multi-Purpose Cleaner, 2 Pack. EPA Safer Choice Formula. Great for Everyday Use Around The Home, Powered by Hydrogen Peroxide, Fresh Scent.
